lead_verdicts.name: JCL
lead_verdicts.reasoning: The complete pinned Linguist row declares one .jcl classification and the source.jcl highlighting scope. The three exact specimens consistently use the MVS JOB, EXEC, DD syntax taught by the archive. IEBCOPY has utility control input after SYSIN DD *, IEFBR14 has an ordinary DD continuation, and IKJEFT01 has TSO/E input after SYSTSIN DD * in a job with TYPRUN=SCAN. The pinned grammar advertises jcl and proc file types. Its editor package registers the same grammar twice by case and lists five extensions.
